Name: Beach Resort Control
Author: mdurham6890
Description: Using the mod config menu the player can completely enable or disable the beach resort being open. Alternatively, the player can choose which days they would like the beach resort to be open. Having the beach resort open can cause scheduling conflicts with some NPCs. This mod allows for the beach resort to be built without having to interact with the sign on the changing rooms every morning to close it for the day.

Manifest.Name: Resort Controller
Manifest.Description: Control when the Ginger Island Beach Resort is open with a master toggle and per-day-of-week settings.
